propositions: Rename the canonical AC qualifier tag from [operator-attested] to [non-codebase] to clarify that the tag denotes WHERE evidence lives (outside codebase) rather than WHO attests it
Retain [operator-attested] as an undocumented backward-compatible alias to avoid reclassifying 827 existing immutable event-sourced tickets that carry the tag

Widen the deterministic regex matcher to accept both spellings case-insensitively using a non-capturing alternation, and update the .rebar/criteria_routing.json activation trigger so [non-codebase]-tagged plans fire project.measurement-provenance

Update all emitter sites (completion_verifier.md, contracts.py, completion_verdict.schema.json, and packaged criteria_routing.json classification vocabulary) to emit kind: "non-codebase" in lockstep, sequencing reader-widening before emitter changes so legacy verdicts render correctly

Regenerate author-facing documentation (writing-a-passing-plan.md, coach_moves.py, generated criteria guide, recognition-side prompts) to use [non-codebase] exclusively while ensuring all tests parametrized over both spellings pass identically
Amend ADR-0043 with a new ADR-0101 recording the rename rationale and that [operator-attested] is a deliberately undocumented compatibility alias
